title: Wang You: Wo Neng Jinghua Yiqie
titleRomaji: Wang You: Wo Neng Jinghua Yiqie
synonyms: Online Game: I Can Evolve Everything
synopsis: Betrayed by his best friend, our protagonist loses everything: billions in wealth, his loved ones, and even his legs. In “Online Game: I Can Evolve Everything,” he gets a second chance at life. Reborn with a burning desire for vengeance, he vows to reclaim everything that was taken from him. When a revolutionary online game arrives, he finds himself at an advantage. No one understands this game better than he does! By getting into the game early and spending heavily, he can acquire a god-level skill known as "Evolve Everything." Now he prepares to exact his revenge. With his unmatched knowledge and newfound powers, he embarks on a journey to dominate the game and take back his rightful place in the world.

title: Life with an Ordinary Guy Who Reincarnated into a Total Fantasy Knockout
titleEnglish: Life with an Ordinary Guy Who Reincarnated into a Total Fantasy Knockout
titleNative: 異世界美少女受肉おじさんと
synonyms: เกิดใหม่ต่างโลก เพื่อนผมน่ารักโฮกเลยครับ
synopsis: Tachibana Hinata and Jinguji Tsukasa are two young men who have been friends since childhood. After a disaster of a singles mixer, they’re sent flying into another world by a mysterious being–and now Tachibana is a beautiful blonde girl! When Jinguji angrily demands that they be returned home and go back to normal, they get cursed, and the only way out is for them to go on a quest and defeat the demon king. But…now the two friends can’t stop thinking about how hot the other is. Will they save the world before their lifelong bromance becomes a romance? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Ranked 19th place of Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category.

title: A Windflower Embroidery
synonyms: I Remember the Love for My Angel
synopsis: Meet Julio, a gay thirty-year-old man and best-selling author. Despite his success in publishing, however, Julio lives a life of solitude, keeping his true identity a secret while harboring feelings of inferiority regarding his sexuality and bland appearance. His world is soon turned upside-down, though, when he encounters a beautiful young man by the name of Angel. Standing up against the world's discriminations and prejudices, the two are soon captivated by each other... Dedicated to all who are seeking romance, this is a story of cinematic human love!! (Source: Renta!)

title: Salt Friend
synopsis: The delinquent Tong Yang was suspended after getting into a fight on the first day of school. Upon return, he was shunned by all his classmates. The top-scorer Xiao Zhen ran into Tong Yang hidden away crying by himself. Tong Yang tried to act tough, but his bluster only got him beat up instead. But for some reason, Xiao Zhen began to tutor Tong Yang after school, until Tong Yang found out that the boy who fought him that day was Xiao Zhen's little brother... (Source: Kuaikan, translated) Note: The series was originally self-published on Jing Jian’s Weibo blog. Currently releasing on Kuaikan Manhua and Bilibili Manhua since July 31, 2021.

synopsis: Gaku is the son of former Japanese national volleyball star Kei Shishiya. Through middle school, he's played as his team's ace hitter, though part of him wonders if that's a title he earned, or one he was simply given. One day, Kei meets Noboru, a generational volleyball talent with a monstrous spiking arm, and vows to turn him into the next national standout. In the wake of that choice, Gaku realizes he can't play the style his father demands, but swears he'll defeat both Kei and Noboru with a game that's entirely his own. (Source: K MANGA)

synonyms: TSUYOSHI: The one who no one can win against
Tsuyoshi ไอ้หนุ่มหมัดพิฆาตลูกป๋องแป๋ง
synopsis: Tsuyoshi Kawabata is just a regular convenience store employee in a mid-sized city west of Tokyo. Except... he also happens to be the most powerful fighter in the world. Although he doesn't particularly want to fight, his reputation precedes him, and martial artists come from all over the world to test their might against the mythical Tsuyoshi – and invariably end up handily beaten, clutching their battered family jewels in a convenience store parking lot. Should you wish to fight him, he has three rules to minimize inconvenience: 1) You only get one fight. There will be no rematch. 2) You will fight in a secluded area, where you won't be seen. 3) You will tell nobody about it – even if you lose.

title: Arabesque Koukyuu no Wakoku-hime
titleNative: アラベスク後宮の和国姫
synopsis: Lyra, a consort whose name will be passed down to future generations as a legend, was originally a princess of the Kingdom of Wa. She was captured in a conspiracy and forced into the harem of the Daril Empire. However, in this harem, she had a path to freedom if she remained childless for several years! This gave her hope, and she resolved not to approach the Sultan, but to wait until her term of indenture expired. However, she was soon tested by the Empress and provoked by a haughty consort candidate. Lyra overcame numerous adversities by displaying the intelligence and natural cheerfulness forged by her parents. She gradually became beloved by those around her, and even showed glimpses of her potential as a wise ruler... But as a result, why has she risen to the top and been treated as a favorite concubine? (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Teto X Egen
synopsis: Ha-Seon, a “workaholic” for whom her company and job are her whole life, and Seon-Ho, a “homebody” whose world consists only of his home and his cat. These two seemed as unlikely to cross paths as parallel lines. But not only are they assigned to the same task force, it turns out they’re actually neighbors, and their daily lives begin to get tangled up. Just when things are getting complicated, Seon-Ho’s first love shows up…! What will become of this precarious yet strangely thrilling relationship between two people who lived in completely different worlds? (Source: Millie, translated)

title: Comet-san
synopsis: The story revolves around Princess Comet, a twelve-year-old girl who is also the princess of the Harmonica Star country of the Triangle Nebula. She was meant to meet the prince of the Tambourine Star country at a ball, but the prince ran away to Earth instead. As it turned out, Comet is sent to Earth to find him, though she has no idea what he looks like. "He will be known by the twinkling in his eyes" is the only clue she was given to the prince's identity. Once she travels to Earth, Comet falls in love with the people she meets there as well as the planet itself, quickly becoming attached to life on Earth. (Source: Wikipedia)

synopsis: "Don’t you think it’s stupid to be so madly in love?" Princess Letitia is due to be executed by guillotine, for the terrible crimes she committed trying to win back her fiancee's love. However, just when she thought she was dead, she was returned back in time for a second chance at life. "I won’t fall in love in my new life. I’m going to live peacefully by becoming a sober, hard-working student with glasses!” But one day, her glasses slip off and Camilo, the school's superstar, sees her true face. Then, for some reason, Camilo begins to dote on her in a tidal wave of affection…!? (Source: Comic Days, translated)

title: Agnes Kamen
synopsis: Professional wrestler Yamamoto Jingo just returned to Japan from a 5 year training trip in the US and Mexico, only to be greeted by his now defunct wrestling company: Yamato. He's come to find out that as soon as the president of the company passed away, the rival wrestling group "Teijitsu" took down Yamato. Jingo has now been forced to go seek revenge for the destruction of Yamato by challenging the Teijitsu president. One thing led to another, and now Jingo has been half-forced into working under Teijitsu as the new wrestler from Brazil: Agnes Kamen. (Source: MangaHelpers)
